question_text: A 67-year-old woman presents to the infectious disease clinic after her PPD was found to be positive. A subsequent chest radiography shows a cavity in the apex of the right upper lobe, along with significant hilar adenopathy. The patient is diagnosed with tuberculosis and is started on the standard four-drug treatment regimen. Four weeks later, she returns for her first follow-up appointment in panic because her eyes have taken on an orange/red hue. Which of the following describes the mechanism of action of the drug most likely responsible for this side effect?
